description: Zones de stationnement payant - Ville de Biarritz is a dataset listed in Mairie de Biarritz : Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Biarritz - Service Mobilités. Localisation des zones de stationnement payant. La ville de Biarritz dispose de plus de 1800 places de stationnement de surface payant réparties en 4 zones (rouge, orange, verte et jaune). Pour régler son stationnement, il existe 2 moyens de paiement au choix: les applis dédiées et l'horodateur. Coverage: Biarritz. The portal files it under Stationnement. Its keywords are stationnement, stationnement payant. The portal shows 31 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-biarritz-fr-portal.
